Name: Seraiah, Son of Hilkiah
Role: Ruler of the House of God
Summary: Priest dwelling in Jerusalem, son of Hilkiah, in the line of Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, and ruler of the house of God (Nehemiah 11:11). Not Seraiah the father of Ezra.
LifeLesson: Two men named Seraiah served God in different generations; the record tells them apart by their fathers.
